subject: Targeted sample conduit: exchange plan and closure cadence
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@retailpilot.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Targeted sample conduit: exchange plan and closure cadence

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, RetailPilot would like a short, staged exchange of evaluation assets (targeted testcases + a small prompt pack) so your engineers can validate the regression profile on the new cart search model. Attached is a compact "sample_manifest_v1.csv" that lists the initial deliverables we propose: ~2k anonymized testcases, a 30-example prompt pack, and a short readme.

Proposal (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): mutual NDA + delivery of probe assets (read-only Drive folder).
- Week 1: RetailPilot runs ingest tests on a dev sandbox; Redwood provides a vetted model variant and a one-week ephemeral sandbox token.
- Week 2: Quality checkpoints — RetailPilot returns an acceptance checklist (pass/fail + a prioritized failure list).
- Week 3: Final handback and deletion of the ephemeral dataset per agreed retention rules.

Constraints: assets are delivered for evaluation only; no redistribution or productization without a commercial license. We propose a short MAP (mutual action plan) that lists each milestone owner, acceptance criteria, and date windows — attached as promptpack_readme.pdf and the sample_manifest.

Can you confirm: (1) legal can sign the attached NDA redline? (2) engineering is comfortable with the Week 1 sandbox ingest window? If yes, I’ll circulate a one-page MAP and DocuSign link.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m sync if helpful.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Principal Solutions, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: sample_manifest_v1.csv (csv, 17KB), promptpack_readme.pdf (pdf, 40KB), NDA_redline_RetailPilot.docx (docx, 28KB)

From: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@retailpilot.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@retailpilot.com>, Dev Team <eng+pilot@retailpilot.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Targeted sample conduit: exchange plan and closure cadence

Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear plan and the manifest. A few quick notes from product & procurement:

- Procurement: we need the NDA redline approved before legal releases the sandbox token (cc'd). Please send a one-page MAP we can attach to the PO so procurement has a clear acceptance definition.
- Dev: ingest window looks fine; we prefer a hard cut at 72 hours of ingestion and won’t retain copies beyond the sandbox unless the MAP permits it. That matches our security posture.
- Acceptance criteria: can you confirm the checklist fields (pass/fail, flaky flag, top-5 failure examples) are already in the promptpack_readme? If not, please add them — engineering needs deterministic steps.

If you can circulate a MAP PDF and the DocuSign, procurement will start the PO approval; engineering will schedule the Week 1 ingest for next Tuesday.

Thanks —
Asha Mehta
Head of Product, RetailPilot
asha.mehta@retailpilot.com

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Targeted sample conduit: exchange plan and closure cadence

Hi Asha / Jasmine —

Putting in a short ops runbook and owner map here so procurement has the pieces for the PO. Quick bullets: 

- MAP doc (one page): owner / milestone / acceptance metric / date window. I’ll attach the MAP to the DocuSign envelope (link below) and also put it in the Drive folder so both teams can reference.
- Sandbox token: ephemeral token valid for 7 days; token issued after NDA completes and PO is acknowledged. Token will be scoped to a restricted S3 read-only lane; no outbound egress permitted (we’ll log all calls).
- Acceptance checklist: we include the fields Asha requested (pass/fail, flaky, top-5 failures, sample failure IDs). RetailPilot provides the checklist within 48 hours of ingest completion.
- Remediation / rollback: if failure rate > 12% across core intents, we propose a follow-up 1-week joint debug sprint without further dataset sharing pending mutual sign-off.

I’ve prepared an internal timeline:
- Mon Nov 23: Legal sign NDA (target)
- Tue Nov 24: Procurement attaches MAP + PO ack, sandbox token issued
- Wed Nov 25 – Fri Nov 27: RetailPilot ingest & smoke tests
- Mon Nov 30: Acceptance checklist returned; final close or remediation plan begins

Links: Drive MAP folder — https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/MP-2468-samples
DocuSign envelope (draft) — https://www.docusign.net/RETAILPILOT-MPA-2468
HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/2468

Marissa (cc Karthik) — I left a few optional fields in the MAP for Karthik to confirm the sandbox config (batch windows / max seq length).

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Targeted sample conduit: exchange plan and closure cadence

Asha / team —

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with our risk model. Next steps I’m taking now:

1) I’m sending the DocuSign envelope with the NDA + the one-page MAP attached (link above). Please have legal route the envelope to procurement for the PO cross-ref.
2) I’ll upload a read-only Drive folder with the sample manifest and the 2k probe set as an encrypted tarball; link shared after NDA completes.
3) Karthik will confirm sandbox config — batch window at 256 tokens / continuous KV enabled / 8-concurrent sessions. Karthik: can you confirm by EOD PST?

Asha, if procurement confirms the PO cross-reference number in the DocuSign comment, we’ll issue the sandbox token within 24 hours of signing. If anything changes on your side, flag it here and we’ll adjust the MAP windows.

Thanks everyone — look forward to a smooth ramp.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Principal Solutions, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
